# speckit config

<!-- generated by `speckit generate commands` -->

Read or mutate the merged project configuration (ADR-0041)

## Usage

```text
Usage: speckit config [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>
```

`--json` prints one JSON object enabled stdout.
